# Open Education at Bay Path University

> > Open educational resources platform at Bay Path University providing free textbooks and course materials using Pressbooks for English literature and writing courses.

This site hosts OER (Open Educational Resources) created by Bay Path University faculty including Shannon Compton, William Guida, and Elizabeth Mays. The platform focuses primarily on English literature and composition courses, with comprehensive materials for ENG114 (Critical Reading and Response) and ENG134 (Literary Genres), available in multiple formats including EPUB and MOBI for Kindle.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Pressbooks publishing platform
- Literary analysis and criticism
- Academic writing and essay structure
- Poetry analysis and poetic meter
- Literary devices and techniques
- MLA citation format
- Narrative elements and characterization
- Creative nonfiction and literary journalism
- Shakespeare and iambic pentameter
- Open textbook creation
- ENG134 Literary Genres course
- ENG114 Critical Reading course
- The Rebus Community

## Platform Overview

- [Open Education at Bay Path University](https://open.baypath.edu): Homepage for Bay Path University's open educational resources platform
- [About](https://open.baypath.edu/about): About Bay Path's Pressbooks platform for open education publishing
- [Catalog](https://open.baypath.edu/catalog): Catalog of open textbooks and OER materials at Bay Path University

## ENG134: Literary Genres

- [Literary Terms Chart](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/literary-terms-chart): Reference chart of literary terms and definitions for ENG134 students
- [What is Poetry](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/what-is-poetry): ENG134 introduction to poetry definition, forms, and poetic meter
- [Metaphor, Symbolism, and Symbols](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/metaphor-symbolism-and-symbols): ENG134 lesson on metaphor and symbolism with Shakespeare & Hughes examples
- [Blank Verse](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/blank-verse): ENG134 guide to blank verse and iambic pentameter in Shakespeare & Milton
- [Alliteration](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/alliteration): ENG134 lesson on alliteration as a poetic device with examples
- [Rhythm](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/rhythm): ENG134 lesson on poetic rhythm, meter, and stressed syllables
- [Theme and Conflict](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/theme-and-conflict): ENG134 guide to identifying literary themes and story conflict types
- [Characterization, Perspective, and POV](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/characterization-perspective-and-pov): ENG134 lesson on narrative perspective and character development techniques

## ENG134: Reading Genres

- [Reading Short Fiction](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/reading-short-fiction): ENG134 guide to analyzing short fiction narrative elements and setting
- [Reading Nonfiction](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/reading-nonfiction): ENG134 guide to narrative and informational nonfiction reading strategies
- [What is Creative Nonfiction?](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/what-is-creative-nonfiction): ENG134 introduction to creative nonfiction and literary journalism

## Academic Writing & Research

- [Developing a Thesis and Writing an Intro](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/developing-a-thesis-and-writing-an-intro): ENG134 guide to crafting thesis statements for literary analysis essays
- [MLA In-text Citations](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/mla-in-text-citations): MLA citation guide for in-text citations and signal phrases in ENG134
- [Researching Literature](https://open.baypath.edu/eng134/chapter/locating-sources): ENG134 guide to finding scholarly sources and literary criticism
- [Essay Types](https://open.baypath.edu/eng114/chapter/kp-2-1a): ENG114 guide covering essay types and academic writing genres

## Optional

- [Log In — ENG114 KnowledgePath](https://open.baypath.edu/eng114/wp-login.php): Login page for ENG114 KnowledgePath Pressbooks course access
